title: ISFORMULA spills a logical array over multi-cell ranges, returns #N/A for closed workbooks, and rejects non-reference constants at entry (0x800A03EC)
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, ISFORMULA(reference) returns TRUE/FALSE per cell, spilling a shaped logical array over a multi-cell single-area reference (=ISFORMULA(B2:D4) -> 3x3 logical array, =ISFORMULA(D1#) -> {TRUE;FALSE;FALSE}), returns #SPILL! when a whole-row/whole-column spill (=ISFORMULA(C:D)) exceeds the sheet, returns #N/A for a reference to a closed external workbook, and rejects literal constants or arrays at formula entry (COM 0x800A03EC). All 3,089 full-bank ISFORMULA rows match.
basis: Measured across all 31 ISFORMULA cases in CalcFunc-Evidence readings/cell-context/reference-info.json, DnaCalc dc_nzpw rows 99-100, dc_ylr row 29, and crates/calc-fml/tests/fixtures/entry/excel-entry.tsv; 3,089/3,089 full-bank rows match.
